notablePrerequisites: Clearwater Goblet has at least three charge counters on it.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Clearwater Goblet triggers, causing you to gain at least three life.
At the beginning of your draw step, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose three life, then search your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and put it into your hand.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuflle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Repeat each turn.
